title: Bottom of the 9th
overview:
It's a Whole New Ballgame in the Bottom of the 9th!

- Big league play starts with Big League players. We put 700 of the top pros into this game. We created 3D animations of the real pitching and batting styles of several players - like Belle, Dykstra, Bonds, Gant, Appier, Finley, Perez, O'Neill, Baerga, Rodriguez and others!
- 3-D polygon texture-mapped graphics
- Save your season stats and trades!
- Intuitive batting system mimics real life; if your bat connects high on the ball - you'll hit a grounder, if you're low - it's a fly ball!
- Adjustable Full Season Mode, Playoff Mode, and memory backup to save all the stats!
- The Training Mode lets you brush up on your offensive and defensive skills.
- Realistic sound effects, plus a real time "play-by-play" announcer
